newsitem.title: FRANCE: Five killed in French shootout.
newsitem.headline: Five killed in French shootout.

text.p: Five people, including two paramilitary gendarmes, were shot dead in a family feud in western France on Tuesday, police said.
Early police reports said a man killed his wife and an unidentified person and then shot dead the gendarmes when they rushed to the scene. He later apparently commited suicide.
Two other people were seriously wounded in the incident, in Chateaubourg near Rennes.
